screen.simplerespawn.title: Downed!
config.simplerespawn.enabled.tooltip: Turns Simple Respawn on or off. Off: lethal damage kills as in Vanilla.
config.simplerespawn.onlyWithOtherPlayer: On: knocked down only while another player is online who could help. Off: always (also alone).
config.simplerespawn.bleedOutSeconds.too: Seconds a downed player can wait for help before dying (5-600, default 60).
config.simplerespawn.secondsLostPerDamag: Bleed-out seconds a downed player loses per point of damage (0-30, default 1).
config.simplerespawn.reviveSeconds.toolt: Seconds a helper holds right-click on the downed player (1-30, default 5).
config.simplerespawn.reviveRange.tooltip: Highest distance in blocks between helper and downed player (1.5-8, default 3).
config.simplerespawn.reviveHealth.toolti: Health after a revive, 2 per heart (1-20, default 6 = 3 hearts).
config.simplerespawn.reviveFood.tooltip: Food level after a revive (0-20, default 0); saturation is always 0.
config.simplerespawn.reviveResistanceSec: Seconds of Resistance V right after a revive (0-30, default 3).
config.simplerespawn.reviveWeaknessSecon: Seconds of Weakness after a revive (0-120, default 0 = none).
config.simplerespawn.crawlSpeed.tooltip: Factor on the crawling speed of a downed player (0-1, default 0.5; 0 = cannot move).
config.simplerespawn.mobsIgnoreDowned.to: On: monsters do not target or chase downed players.
config.simplerespawn.announce.tooltip: On: everyone reads in chat when a player is downed or revived.
simplerespawn.guide.page.1.title: Simple Respawn
simplerespawn.guide.page.1: Downed instead of dead: teammates revive you before you bleed out.
simplerespawn.guide.page.2.title: Downed instead of dead
simplerespawn.guide.page.2: Lethal damage knocks a player down instead of killing them, as long as another player is online who could help (config onlyWithOtherPlayers; alone it is the Vanilla death).
simplerespawn.guide.page.3.title: Downed screen
simplerespawn.guide.page.3: An own screen in the style of the Vanilla death screen shows the time left and three buttons: Spectate, Inventory and Give up.
simplerespawn.guide.page.4.title: Reviving
simplerespawn.guide.page.4: A teammate holds right-click on the downed player for 5 seconds (reviveSeconds); afterwards the player stands up with 3 hearts and an empty food bar.
simplerespawn.guide.page.5.title: Fair play
simplerespawn.guide.page.5: Leaving the game while downed is death; the real death is always the Vanilla one, so drops and other mods behave as usual.
simplerespawn.guide.page.6.title: Commands
simplerespawn.guide.page.6: /simplerespawn giveup for the downed player (the Give up button); /simplerespawn down <players> and /simplerespawn revive <players> for game masters.
simplerespawn.guide.page.7.title: Settings
simplerespawn.guide.page.7: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
